nom: Kopari Beauty Sun Shield Soft Glow Daily Face SPF 30

avis.texte: I had bought this product cheaper at a retail store. I had bought from Kopari before their SPF 50 Body Mist Sunscreen, (Amazing!!) and I tried this product and it's truly so good. I use it consistently and it hasn't broke me out, it's not greasy it leaves the perfect glow as someone who has dry skin, I have a bit of oiliness in my T zone but it doesn't affect it too badly. I am pretty sure I've used it under my makeup base before and it didn't separate at all, it blends in really great.

As an avid SPF wearer, I really enjoy a lot of Kopari's products. The soft glow face shield lays beautifully on the skin and feels like it actually absorbs in. Unlike some other glowy SPF products, I don't feel like it'll transfer onto my clothes easily. The formula is lightweight and doesn't flare up my acne-sensitive skin. I've not tried to pair this under makeup, so I don't know for certain if this will pill.
It has glitter and it's very noticeable when outside. It does feel light on skin but I didn't like the actual glitter on my face.

avis.titre: Love the feel, don't love the smell
avis.texte: I love the smooth silky way it makes my skin feel, i just dont love the smell of it. Its very minimal, but makes me less enthused to apply it every day. Its got shimmer to it in the bottle but not very noticeable on skin which is fine with me.
It feels lovely on my skin. And doesn't smell like sunscreen. Absolutely love this product!
I love this kopari sunscreen for the face because it's light, luxurious, and has full coverage. It feels like silk!
Used it every day in the Bahamas for a month! Never burned and it feels so good on your skin and lasts all day!
The sun shield soft glow is like silk going on my skin. I love that it has a built-in SPF and it feels like it moisturizes my skin well.
Okay so I've tried every face spf, this gives great coverage and its so lightweight. Great for hiking or any outdoor activities.
It is so smooth and it does not take much at all to coer your whole face. Very nice

avis.titre: Finally found the face SPF for me!
avis.texte: I have a dry and sensitive face especially when it comes to spf protection. Every sunscreen would have my face stinging, raw, red and a breakout to follow. Needless to say I Didn't use it much. Finding this product changed my skin care completely. I love this. it's sheer yet hydrating. My skin loves it! I also use other Kopari products under: vitamin C daily moisturizer and ceramide cream.

avis.titre: This is a must add and keep on my love it for rebuying
avis.texte: This goes on so beautifully and I don't need to rub it in or anything. It absorbs quickly and has no sticky residue or feeling whatsoever besides moisturized

It seemed great when a consultant helped me try it in the store, but later in the evening, my makeup ended up looking really cakey and made me look older with more noticeable wrinkles. I thought it was the setting spray, but now that I've used it for a couple days, I see it's this product instead. Sad that I'll be returning.

I was so excited to try this product but sadly Ulta sent me an expired bottle. Then, after contacting them, they sent me a replacement that was ALSO expired. Don't purchase expired sunscreen. Purchase directly from Kopari but not from ulta.

Bought this during the sale earlier this year. At first I loved it but after awhile it started coming out separated, no matter how much I tried to shake it up. Also caused endless breakouts. I just read other reviews about receiving expired product, and yep, same here. Product expired in May. Who knows if it was even doing it's job as sunscreen. Very disappointing.
I love this product as it smooths my face and creates a great base, for makeup or tinted moisturizer.

i ordered multiple products yesterday for same day delivery and i am very disappointed that they gave me a expired product on this. it says on the bottle exp 4/2025 and it also look like it was opened. whoever packed it, should double check it.

Bought this item during the 21 days of beauty sale and received in the mail on 9/9/25. The product expired on 06/2025!! Maybe that's why this item was on sale so they can get rid of inventory. Always check the expiration date on your products.
For real though, this is the best face sunscreen on the market.I'm straight addicted and cannot find another to match this product. don't stop production!
Feels like silk on the skin. This is my favorite facial suncreen.

avis.titre: Sun shield soft daily face glow.
avis.texte: I love this sunscreen. It is sheer and gives your skin a beautiful glow. My 5 and 7 year old granddaughters put it on first thing every morning. They say ‚ÄúNana, just like brushing your teeth in the morning you apply your sunscreen‚Äù.

avis.titre: The best facial sunscreen I've ever bought! 20 stars
avis.texte: Ive just started using Kopari products, initially i bought a travel bag with 3 mini size products, loved all of them so i bought full size and this face sunscreen. Of all the products, this is by far my favourite, doesn't feel heavy or leave white reside on your skin. It's incredible, lightweight and feels like silk when applied, like ultralight butter, so satisfying. Doesnt affect make up at all! Id strongly recommend this product, with ulta' return policy allowing you 30 days, its an easy decision.

I went into the store today, and one of the associates Lex recommended me this product to use as a primer. I instantly loved it. So soft, smooth, blend-able and light. Love how it feels and sinks into my skin.
I thought I liked this but after using it for multiple days in a row, my face started breaking out in white heads and the only thing I can think of is that it's too oily.
This product is pretty good! Leaves no white cast, satin finish & has vitamin E. I only wish the SPF were higher and it had a dewy finish instead, for added moisture.
Loved the feel and look after applying but broke out next day. I've been looking (for years) for a sunscreen that doesnt aggravate my sensitive skin, but I'll keep looking!
Huge Kopari fan here, but this product caused an epic breakout. Signs were immediate so I only used it one day. Here I am five days later still trying to calm my skin.
Im fairly fair-skinned. I burn then tan. With this stuff my face burned the three timed I used it. It was like putting on tanning oil like we did in the 90s.

I want to love this. I have started to love the brand. I got this because it is summer time and i wanted the extra protection. I am familiar enough with face products to know that you have to let each product absorb into the skin before applying the next. The directions say to use this after your moisturizer however this looks like it is pilling after i apply it. I dont understand that. It does that even if it is dabbed and not rubbed into the skin. I guess it doesnt work well with moisturizer maybe (i use the jeffree star face moisturizer) i guess i have to play around with it to to find a fix even though you shouldnt have to do that to apply a sunscreen. It also feels very greasy when you first apply it and then it soaks into the skin after a while.
cost a lot for something that smell weird the exp day 8/25 they that has nothing too do
Purchased last summer and it's expired! I hade purchased supergoop multiple times and I get at least 2 summers out of it .. not happy at all

I am fair skinned with red hair and sun protection is a must for me. I have used several kinds of face sunscreen and they have all made my skin breakout except for this one! I have used three bottles and I love it! It goes on silky smooth and works well with different foundations.

avis.titre: Works well only con for me was scent
avis.texte: This Sunglaze sheer setting mist with sunscreen is so beautiful! I love the mist is lightweight. It doesn't leave glitter on your face so don't worry. It's a great way to set your makeup and provide SPF protection. It's also great for reapplying during the day. The only con is the scent. I get a strong alcohol scent from it. I love all the other body spf products and those ones smell amazing. Gifted by Kopari.
This is my new obsession. It goes on so smooth and silky, i don't even feel it on.
ABSOLUTELY LOVE THIS SUNSCREEN, SMOOTH AND NONSTICKY. PLUS IT HAS PRIMER IN IT FOR A SILKY ASMOOTH FINISH.
I loved everything about this except my face burned everytime i used it.

I do like this sunscreen, some people complained it was oily. I have oily mature skin and I like the way this feels. You do need to shake it and mix the properties together after sitting. I only wear a tinted moisturizer, no foundation, so I don't know if that makes a difference. It does not feel or smell like sunscreen to me.

I'm not sure what happened but I used this on back of my hand to see how it felt. Felt nice and soft. I applied then to face. Within a couple hours I was so itchy! Back of my hand and my face. I love the rest of my products from kopari but this is a no for me. It took days for the redness and swelling and itch to go away. I guess check ingredients if you know something you are allergic to. I have no idea which ingredient did this to me.

The last bottle I bought was thicker. The new bottle is a thinner consistency. Not sure if they changed the formula. I do like the coverage and wear it daily under make up. It leaves a little iridescent glow under my make up.
I love this. I ordered one for my sister. We are hooked. Merry Christmas to everyone! You are all getting it.
I am loving this sunscreen! It goes on so smooth and it's lightweight. Beautiful finish for under my makeup
Feels like heavy silicone on my face, clogs my pores, and just feels gross. SPF 30 isn't really high enough for sun protection either. The "glow" was barley visible on my light-medium skin tone.

I have medium brown, dry skin and once its set its not oily at all. I love the glow it gives but if i sweat it will get in my eyes and burn but not as bad as super goop play. I love the murad more but this is my go to on days im staying inside mostly. Arizona has extremely high Uv index all day, i would not use this outside again or near water. Anywhere you will sweat excessively . Its very light and comfortable but its better as a inside spf or driving spf.

I saw this on social media and thought I would try it. It's literally the best sunscreen I've ever used. Glides on so nice and works really well. I always share it so my friends can see how awesome it is.
Absolutely love it. Love the way it feels on my skin and it doesn't irritate it at all
This lotion makes my skin so supple and soft. I am in love with this moisturizer.
Not sweat resistant and I got a sunburn, don't bother for the price.

I liked the gel full body version so much that I went back and bought this face one, a travel pack for myselfs and my sisters and a full size of the 50 spf for my mom. It's dropping a lil bit now to save face later. Skin cancer runs in my family (with 2 grandparents and 1 parent having chunks removed from their face and body).... So I am obsessive about avoiding it. I'm not going to get any pretty missing part of my nose lol. This stuff glides on smoothly on top of other skincare products. Make sure your face is dry enough. I don't want to scratch it off my face immediately after applying. It's high allergy season where I live so can't comment on the smell.

I'm an esthetician and have some of the oiliest skin. I would always skip SPF if I was wearing makeup because many of them I've tried, make my makeup break down faster throughout the day. I tried this one out after trying it out in the store and to me it absorbs like a dry oil, and I can't feel it on my skin after a few minutes. I haven't had any issues with my skin over producing oil while wearing this alone or under makeup. I hope they don't stop making this product!

This goes on really nice on my face. It literally glides on like butter without the greasy feeling. I like that it has shimmer but it does not show up on your face as glitter, it's more of a glowy satin finish. I haven't noticed any pilling on bare skin or with makeup. I've paired this with Bare Minerals tinted moisturizer and it looks great. When pairing with makeup i put it on before my makeup.
Didn't come with a pump so I have to scrape out the entire sun screen or hit it against something idk how I'm gonna be able to get out the rest of the sun screen

Most sunscreens feel heavy but the formula of this is so so light and airy. I am a sucker for shimmer, so having the extra shimmer in this gives you that extra glow.

This is the only sunscreen I've had that doesn't break me out. I've tried all of the top sunscreens and have also tried many Korean skin care sunscreens. This is the only one that doesn't break me out nor does it pill. I don't feel that it is oily, it's feels more slightly silicone like? But it's very light and absorbs into the skin and gives a really nice glow but not too much. I'd recommend anyone give it a try. I feel that the "smell" is also very subtle and disappears fast. I don't even really notice a smell but maybe others are more sensitive.

I'm sad because a face spf is really important. Hope it works better for others. I did love all the other oils in the bundle. They were 5 stars.

avis.titre: I hate sunscreen on my face but love this stuff
avis.texte: It is so silky and light weight. I enjoy wearing it rather than dreading it like other sun screens. I wear it under my purlisse cc cream and my skin looks so good. (50 yr old with light combo skin).

avis.titre: finally a sunscreen i can stand!
avis.texte: i thought wearing sunscreen meant accepting stinging and irritation on my sensitive skin until this profuct. while it feels a little odd to use a dry oil all over my face, the texture is so soothing and never pills. it dries down within 1 minute on my normal-to-dry skin and i've never had a problem with layering makeup. i dont love the sparkles, but i'll take that over white-cast, pilling, and irritation any day!

avis.titre: probably more suited for dry skin
avis.texte: there's shimmer in this and I personally don't need that in my sunscreen (I got it free w/ a kopari purchase). I wouldn't mind that too much but the product makes me look greasy. this might be really good for people with dry skin.

Purchased this at my local Ulta in El Segundo, CA. Was approached by a Kopari representative, Elena, and she heard me out on searching for a new sunscreen. As an avid Supergoop! buyer, I have to say I love the feel of this Kopari Sun Shield even more. It glides on smooth, NO residue whatsoever, and after applying my tinted moisturizer on top it makes my skin look incredibly even. And there's no feeling of greasiness at all! So shoutout to Elena from Kopari for being an amazing listener, and can't wait to enjoy more!

Got this as it had such high remarks and wanted something that was a little easier to apply. I appreciate the bottle and application and that a little goes a long way, but that's it. It makes my face greasy and my makeup separates after use. A thing I've been trying to avoid. There was such a stark difference with the kinship probiotic mineral sunscreen I've been using. Maybe it just doesn't mix with my particular water-based foundation, but beware.

This is the first suncreen for face that ive enjoyed using. I have sensitive skin and sunscreens typically burn my face…not this one. It feels like a skin care primer…no tackiness or dry time needed. It even blurred for me. Love it! I want to try their other products now!

I have to agree with another reviewer. This product does feel like silk going onto the skin! It glides right on and makes my skin feel so soft, and it lasts all day. I really prefer the texture of this better than any of my other facial spf's, it just feels that nice!

The matte effect doesn't feel moisturizing enough on my skin and I don't feel that it leaves a glow like the label states. I am more keen on Kopari's mineral sunscreen.
